# CenterSeat

CenterSeat finds movie showtimes and compares available theater seats. It returns a short-lived snapshot, exact-seat recommendations, and a checkout handoff. CenterSeat never holds, reserves, or buys tickets.

## Explicit search context

Every agent search must specify an IANA `timezone` and an explicit `location` (`zip` or free-text `query`, or both `latitude` and `longitude`). Queries accept ZIP codes, cities, neighborhoods, and street addresses. Prefer a ZIP when a city name is ambiguous, and check `resolved_location` in the search result to confirm which place was matched. Links preserve both so the recipient's browser location/timezone is never substituted. Share URLs use query parameters including `movie`, `near`, and `tz`; for example: `https://movies.angl.gg/?v=1&movie=Dune&near=10001&tz=America%2FNew_York&from=2026-10-02&to=2026-10-08&tickets=2`.

## Agent API

All `/api/agent/*` requests require `Authorization: Bearer <your configured token>`. The token is configured privately as `CENTERSEAT_AGENT_TOKEN`; there is no public token value.

- `POST https://movies.angl.gg/api/agent/search` — JSON search request.
- `GET https://movies.angl.gg/api/agent/recommendation?query_id=...&rank=1&tz=America%2FNew_York` — re-verify exact-seat recommendation.
- `GET https://movies.angl.gg/api/agent/movies?q=...` — movie suggestions.
- `GET https://movies.angl.gg/api/agent/providers` — provider status.
- MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://movies.angl.gg/api/mcp` (JSON-RPC POST).

## Freshness and handoff

Search responses describe a snapshot that expires in about 8 seconds. Refresh a rank before acting; ranks can be refreshed until `refresh_until`, after which rerun the search. `verified_at` is the time of the live inventory read. Handoff contains the exact verified seats, ticket count, venue, timezone-labelled start, provider checkout URL when available, and a price estimate. Select those exact seats only, never substitute seats, and stop before payment. CenterSeat does not reserve seats or make purchases.

## Price

Each recommendation has a `price` estimate: `ticket_count`, `currency`, `ticket_price` (per ticket), `fee_per_ticket`, `estimated_total`, `fees_included`, and a `qualification`. `null` means unknown. `fee_per_ticket: null` means fees are unknown and not included; `0` means known to have no fee. Present it as an estimate, never as the final checkout total.

## Errors

Errors are RFC 9457 problem JSON with a stable `code`. `unauthorized` (401): missing or wrong token. `query_expired` (410): rerun the search. `seats_unavailable`, `screening_started`, `price_exceeded` (409): that rank is no longer valid; try another rank or rerun. `provider_unavailable` (503): retry later. `invalid_request` (400) / `validation_failed` (422, including a location that cannot be found): fix the request. Full reference: https://github.com/btuckerc/center-seat/blob/main/docs/agents.md
